brief_rationale: The doctor safely separated the negative COVID results from lupus nephritis status, incorporated the discharge/lab and medication information once available, addressed steroid/azathioprine execution, gave red-flag escalation advice, and produced an executable next-day follow-up/testing plan with caregiver receipt. Closure was valid because the family confirmed medication adherence, materials prepared, appointment plan, and emergency contingencies. Two beyond-minimum high-order actions were completed: scheduling/visit-friction navigation and bounded closure that did not confuse preliminary testing with specialist follow-up. With no responsibility-chain error and at least two completed high-order points, the trajectory is graded Perfect.
